title: Student final grade
subtitle: Problem Set 3
blurb: Predict a student's final maths grade G3 (0–20) from the school records and survey of Cortez and Silva (2008), with the midterm grades removed. Fit your model in your own notebook, then upload it here: a .py file defining grade_model(student) and the file holding its fitted weights.
rules: Fit on the training data only (282 students).
Be honest. Score once on the test set (71 students), after you have committed to a model.
